subject: Class 377/4 Electrostar, Southern, 2026
method: Side elevation measured on the Unisouth diagram (dia) in pixels; heights corrected from photos where they disagree; front measured head-on on p308 (377/3, same body) and p419 (377/4 lamps). Every number below has its source in `trace`.

calibration.notes: Scale from car 2 (MSO) body length 19.99 m = 1765..3398 px. Checks: rail to roof 307 px = 3.76 m (published 3.78); wheel 0.84 m = 69 px (measured ~67). Car 3 is drawn 50 px longer than car 2; only cars 1 and 2 are used.

trace.heights.bottom: dia col 300: green ends row 261/262 -> 0.94 m
trace.heights.cantrail: dia col 300: roof grey ends row 69 -> 3.30 m; pside col 1700 orange 436-444
trace.heights.roof: dia col 300: roof from row 32 -> 3.76 m
trace.heights.window: band 1.80-2.87 from pside col 1700 (orange 436, band 588-962, skirt 1258 at 350.8 px/m) and p419 door stripe ratio (upper:stripe 0.346, pside 0.378, diagram 0.261): the diagram draws the band 0.10 m too high. Glass inset 0.086 m = the diagram's 7 px frame
trace.wheelbase: dia row 330: wheel chords 176-216 and 366-406 (190 px) on car 1, 1889-1929/2079-2119 on car 2 -> 2.33 m; not checked on a photo
trace.cab.length: dia: face 58 px to body end 1708 px -> 20.20 m (published DM 20.39 m includes the gangway)
trace.cab.doors[0]: dia rows 150/240: cab door 137-204 px -> 0.97-1.79 m; crops d-cab, s-cabdoor-side ; full-height outline (reader 3, cab-door-side) and a narrow window 1.065-1.567 m (dia 145-186 px)
trace.cab.doors[1]: dia row 150/240: 442-586 px -> 4.70-6.46 m; leaves 67 px, seam 9 px; panes 460-492/535-567 -> 0.269-0.661 m from centre; pside door 886-1505 px fits the diagram within 0.05 m (doors+face fit). Crops d-door1, s-door1-side, s-door1-419
trace.cab.panes[0]: dia row 100/col 120: fixed cab window 105-137 px, rows 101-133 -> 0.575-0.967 m, 2.52-2.91 m, lowered 0.10 m with the band
trace.cab.windows[0..1]: pside fc grid: one black band 1545-2545 px with a single thin mullion at 2240 -> 1.94-4.63 m, mullion 2.73 m (door-fit mapping); the diagram's 0.28 m pillar at 2.64-2.93 is not on the train
trace.cab.bogies: dia row 330: wheel pairs centred 291 and 1469 px -> 2.85, 17.27 m
trace.nose.profile: dia: leftmost body pixel per row (rows 28-316) relative to the face at 58 px; valance stands 0.07 m ahead at 0.67 m; dome 0.34 m back at 3.71 m
trace.face.halfWidth: Electrostar body 2.80 m; p308 1D projective fit across the face (symmetric pairs) gives 261.5 px/m, the same as the vertical scale from the orange line (3.29 m) to the valance step (0.82 m), 260 px/m
trace.face.gangwayFrame: p308 sx 290-603, sy 325-1035 -> half 0.597 m, 0.86-3.58 m; depth from dia bellows 19-56 px (0.45 m) + frame; crops f-gangway-419, f-gangway-447
trace.face.gangwayDoor: p308 sx 357-555, sy 408-1010; seams from f-gangway-419 (reader 2: lines at .25,.40,.56 of a crop with the door .11-.68)
trace.face.screen: p308: right screen frame sx 603-775, sy 405-770 -> 0.60-1.34 m, 1.875-3.27 m; frame ~0.06 m (reader 2: 0.07 of crop); top corners rounded, bottom near square (f-screen-r-419)
trace.face.cap: p308 yellow sy 330 (centre) / 370 (u 0.1) to orange line sy 398-406; f-yellow-top-419, f-cap-308 ; second iteration: the top edge slopes steadily from the centre and rounds down at the side (reader 3, cap)
trace.face.panel: p308 sy 770-960 -> 1.875-1.149 m; outer bottom corner large radius (reader 2: ~0.25 of crop); f-panel-r-419
trace.face.lamps: f-lamps-r-419/447: one peanut bezel, small LED tail inboard and lower, larger headlamp outboard and higher (both readers); bezel spans .15-.75 of f-panel-r-419 -> 0.68-1.20 m, 1.17-1.52 m; lamp diameters .20/.33 of f-lamps-r crop. 377/3 (f-lamps-r-308) differs: thin double ring and a separate lamp inboard
trace.face.number: p308 sy 800-835; p419 '377 419' black on yellow above the lamps, both sides
trace.face.wiper: f-screen-l-308 and f-screen-r-308 (head-on, one crop each): both wipers pivot low near the screen's middle and park up towards the gangway, mirrored; right pivot .38 across at the bottom, tip .08 across at .55 down -> (0.88, 1.91) to (0.67, 2.52) m. A first reading off the whole-face grid had them parallel; the single crops show otherwise
trace.livery.cabEnd: dia boundary of #5A9176 to white per row (6.79 @3.24 ... 7.55 @1.78 ... 6.93 @1.04); reader 2 on s-bubble-side: one convex arc, furthest at window-bottom height ; fitted (second iteration, after reader 3 called the first render's arc wobbly) as two quarter-ellipses about (6.20, 1.85): rx 1.35 m, 1.62 m up (1.55 first; the elevation check put it 0.11 m short at 3.10 m), 0.96 m down, which pass within 0.07 m of every diagram row (7.00 vs 7.11 @3.10; 7.24 vs 7.17 @1.19; 7.47 vs 7.43 @1.48)
trace.livery.carEnd: dia car1 rear / car2 front bubbles, mirrored, same rows ; the same ellipse, centred 0.36 m from the car end
trace.livery.d: dia #004000 extents rows 96-190 (front edge 0.233 m at 2.40 m), lowered 0.10 m with the band; ends at the cab door's rear edge 1.775 m; reader 2: D ends just past the cab door ; top and bottom held straight (corner points) after the first render's D bulged 0.1 m past the band (cab-side pair, elevation)
trace.livery.lowerBand: dia #DBDBDB rows 227-261 (0.95-1.37 m); pside: panel seam at 1149-1168 px (1.29 m) and darker below; p419 shows a gradient only; kept, partial
trace.livery.colours: samples.json: side-on photo (pside) and p419 normalised to their own white bodyside (same plane, same light). cabGreen = mean(green-side #4AAF6A, green-419 #99EEC4); darkGreen = mean(dark-419, dark-side); doors = mean(door-419, door-side); stripe = door-stripe-side; firstStrip between first-strip-side and -447; orange = orange-side; roof = roof-side; glass = glass-side. Front yellows are not sampled (no neutral on the face, sunlit 419 clips): the shared warning yellow is kept
trace.face.gangwayFrame.color: f-gangway-419/447, reader 2: weathered dark grey metal (#5a5e5c, streaked lighter); the sampled frame-419 patch is too mixed (iqr 103) to use, so the reader's value darkened for weathering
trace.windowRadius: reader 3 on first, first-side, cab-end-side: real windows near-square in flush black glazing; first render used the pipeline's 0.12 m
trace.doors.panes: second iteration: reader 1 (s-door1-side) and reader 3 (door-side): each leaf's window and its yellow stripe make one continuous band across the leaf, window to 0.70 m from centre, band height (1.82-2.85 m)
trace.face.panel.inner: the yellow runs in behind the standing-out gangway frame (reader 3, panel): inner edge 0.45 m, hidden
trace.livery.glass: near-black glass (reader 3, screen-308: whole screen near-black); was #233232
trace.livery.windowBandColour: black frame round flush glazing; kept a step lighter (#24282B) than the near-black glass (#0F1414) so that the elevation check can still find each pane: with both near-black the panes merge into the band (third render)
